lines.text: [excited] Omega! I applied to three hundred jobs this month.
[flatly] How many replies?
[deflated] One. [reading] "We went with someone more aligned."
[dry] Someone who read the job description.
[defensive] I read some of them.
[sighs] Okay. [warmly] I built you a job hunter. It's free. Watch.
Step one. It pulls fresh entry-level jobs from Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, and Simplify.
[hopeful] So no more "entry level, five years of experience"?
Filtered. It has standards. [dry] One of us should.
Step two. No duplicates. Same job, never twice.
[sheepish] I applied to Google four times.
[sighs] I know. [dry, amused] So does Google.
Step two. One résumé file builds every version. [firmly] Over one page, the build fails.
[eager] Can it add "fast learner" and "team player"?
[deadpan] It only writes facts. That's why yours fits on one page.
Step three. Claude Code agents apply in a real browser while you sleep.
[curious] How do I know it actually sent?
No screenshot, no confirmation, it doesn't count. It keeps receipts. [pointedly] You should try it.
[excited] Okay. Run it on every job. Use my card for the application fees.
[firmly] No. It never pays fees. Never solves a CAPTCHA. [dry] And a file called STOP freezes everything.
[confused] So what's my job?
[dry] Getting the job. [softer] I just get you in the room.
[shouting, excited] Omega. I got an interview!
[smug] I know. I drafted your thank-you email.
[excited] Send it!
[flatly] I draft. You send. [dry] I'm not doing the interview either.
Comment HUNT, and I'll send you the repo.
